items.title: Dave Robinson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] It just popped into my head, do you include — you know Paul Simon did that song called “You Can Call Me Al”? [INTERVIEWEE] Right. That was Ronnie Cuber on his one and only appearance on bass sax.

ctx.x: Yeah. I mean the major manufacturers for the most part aren’t making them but there are some being made by specialty manufacturers. And boy it just seems like, I mean there’s whole mailing lists on the internet devoted to bass saxophone.
It just popped into my head, do you include — you know Paul Simon did that song called “You Can Call Me Al”?
Right. That was Ronnie Cuber on his one and only appearance on bass sax.
